data.name: Indradev
data.gender_notes: Indradev is used as a male name in Hindu naming traditions.
data.long_meaning: Indradev is a Sanskrit name derived from the words 'Indra' (the Hindu god of rain, thunder, and war) and 'dev' (god). This name signifies the divine power and leadership associated with Indra. The name Indradev carries the meaning “Lord of Indra” and is chosen by families in Hindu traditions for the positive qualities it expresses. Linguistically it belongs to the Sanskrit tradition and is also used in Hindi, Sanskrit, Marathi. Parents who choose Indradev usually hope their child will grow to embody lord of indra and live with faith, good character and purpose.
data.spiritual_meaning: Indradev is a powerful name that represents leadership, strength, and the ability to control the elements of nature. It is a name for those who aspire to lead and rule with wisdom and grace.
data.etymology: Indradev belongs to the Sanskrit linguistic tradition and is used in Hindu naming. Its recorded meaning is “Lord of Indra.”
data.numerology_meaning: In Pythagorean numerology the letters of Indradev total 5, giving a life-path number of 5. Number 5 is linked with Mercury and with the qualities of freedom, adaptability and curiosity.

This name is much cherished in Hindu communities, especially those that place great importance on the ancient Hindu mythology and the stories surrounding the gods. Indradev is also a name that implies a deep connection to nature, as Indra is the god who controls the elements, especially rain. The name carries with it the blessings of the god Indra for a productive agricultural cycle, prosperity, and good fortune.
data.spiritual_significance: From a spiritual perspective, Indradev is a name that symbolizes divine protection, guidance, and blessings. The name suggests a deep inner strength and resilience, drawing inspiration from the legends of Indra, who wielded the power of thunder and rain and was known for his fierce determination. The name Indradev invokes the idea of the universe being interconnected, and that the individual carrying this name is part of that divine order. It suggests That the person carrying this name is considered to be a divine representative of Indra and is expected to embody the god's qualities of courage, leadership, and divine protection.
